note: Timing, CDC, and power are the three pillars of FPGA physical implementation quality
Async FIFOs are the primary mechanism for CDC data transfer
FSMs are the primary target of state and transition coverage verification
SERDES interfaces create the tightest timing constraints in FPGA designs
DSP pipelines are a dominant power consumer in signal processing FPGAs
Simulation verification and hardware debug are complementary: simulation finds logic bugs, hardware debug finds physical implementation issues
Device selection determines the power and timing budget available
DSP pipelines often feed or consume data from serial interfaces
FIFOs buffer data between serial interfaces and processing logic
Protocol layer state machines control serial link bring-up and data flow
CDC bugs are a primary class of issues found during hardware debug
DSP block count is a critical factor in FPGA device selection for signal processing
CDC verification is a distinct discipline within the overall verification methodology
